pages.text: Many fluids boiled together separate only if the column is hot enough for the heaviest and the reflux high enough to keep them apart: the separation is S = R/(R+1)·exp(−|T_c − T_b|/300). The column must stay below the coils' limit.
$(thing)Set$(): Column temperature, Reflux ratio.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): The mixture's boiling point wanders by ±15%·d.

$(thing)Limits$(): Reflux above 25: the column floods; The fluids do not separate (S below 0.2): bring the column to their boiling point; The coils are overheating.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): The cleaner the separation, the faster the Essence comes off.
$(thing)Equations$()$(br)Mixture boiling point: T_b = 600 K·(1 + 0.15·d)$(br)Separation: S = R/(R+1)·e^(−|T_c−T_b|/300)$(br)Reboiler duty: Q = 0.05·T_c·(R+1)
